content: We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule, reproduces the reaction described (Still-Gennari). We have previous step: make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 gave precursors list: two SMILES: product? Actually answer: "[['C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](OC(=O)CP(=O)(CC(F)(F)F)CC(F)(F)F)[C@H]1C)CO', 'CC(C)(C)[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F']]" So applying some template gave those two precursors. The template ID unknown. Need to find template that matches this transformation. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional groups broken/formed as described: broken: alkyne triple bond, carbon-phosphorus bond, carbon-carbon bond, carbon-oxygen bond? Actually description: "Thus, a carbon-carbon double bond, and a carbon-oxygen are formed, while a carbon-phosphorus bond, a carbon-carbon bond and a carbon-oxygen bond are broken. Additionally, the triple bond of an alkyne is changed to a single bond." So broken functional groups: C-C triple bond (alkyne), C-P bond? Not in functional groups list. Also C-C single bond? Not functional group. But we can search for templates that produce C-C double bonds and carboxylic esters formed. Already attempted search with broken C-C triple bonds and formed C-C double bonds, carboxylic esters. Got empty list. Maybe need to include functional_groups_broken: ["C-C triple bonds", "C-P bonds"? Not in list. Let's see available functional groups list includes "C-C double bonds", "C-C triple bonds", "carboxylic esters". No C-P. So we can just specify broken alkyne. Already did. No results. Maybe need to search without specifying broken, just formed.
